issues.display_title: Issue #4223: Route legacy PayPal (Payflow Pro) unsubscribe to Support contact
issues.main_description_html:
Context

Legacy PayPal recurring profiles (RP..., managed by Payflow Pro) could be "unsubscribed" from the dashboard, but the API flow only wrote a local unsubscribes row — the Payflow profile was never cancelled and kept billing. Verified case: user #26912 was downgraded to subscribtion=0 yet Payflow charged them again on 2026-08-27 (next charge 2026-09-27).

What was done

API (GoThru-API-New, already on main)

  • Temporarily block processPaypalUnsubscribeLegacy() — requests now return 409: "Unable to process PayPal legacy cancellation. Please contact support@gothru.co."
  • No local writes (no unsubscribes row, no profile reset, no emails) until the Payflow cancel call is wired in.

Frontend (this repo, development)

  • Unsubscribe.jsx: detect legacy profiles via recurring_profile starting with RP
    • Modal becomes informational: blue info box explaining cancellation is handled personally by the Support Team
    • Other messages (BASIC downgrade box, Virtual Tour warning, "Are you sure?" text) hidden for this condition
    • Footer "Unsubscribe" button replaced with Contact → mailto:support@gothru.co with prefilled:
      • Subject: Unsubscribe Request (Payflow Pro) - User #{id}
      • Body: request + User ID, Email, RP profile, user name
    • encodeURIComponent used (not URLSearchParams) so mailto spaces render as %20, not +
    • Stripe / PayPal-new (I-...) flow unchanged
  • i18n: t_unsubscribe_info.t_legacy_paypal.* added to all 18 locales

Commits

  • e8a939e06 feat(payment): route legacy PayPal (Payflow Pro) unsubscribe to support contact
  • b7a7af17d chore(i18n): simplify legacy PayPal unsubscribe modal copy for users
  • 11ef76e6e fix(payment): show only support info in legacy PayPal unsubscribe modal
  • f094a0b98 fix(payment): encode mailto body with %20 so spaces render correctly
  • 722e5ed4d i18n: add legacy PayPal unsubscribe keys to all locales

Follow-ups

  • Wire real Payflow Pro recurring-cancel API call in GoThru-API-New, then remove the temporary 409 block in Unsubscribe::handle()
  • Decide on user #26912's active profile RP0000004540 (next charge 2026-09-27): cancel manually via Payflow or refund
  • Live backfill record-payflow-recurring-transactions cron (Aug 4 → now, 77 unrecorded recurring transactions)

issues.display_title: Issue #4235: Integrate Nested Menu Hierarchy in Template Match View (API V2)
issues.main_description_html:
Ref: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1825

Summary

Backend API V2 (GET /v2/templates/menu/match) has been implemented to support arbitrary multi-level nested menus (sub_menus).

Currently, gothru-dashboard expects the legacy V1 flat 2-level structure (main and sub), causing deep hierarchy menus to either lose nesting or fail during parsing. This task covers migrating the frontend matching interface and data flow to consume the V2 recursive tree structure, support flat selection with merged duplicate pano IDs, and bypass matching when templates have no real panorama targets.

Technical Context & Scope

1. Pre-Check & Endpoint Migration (src/pages/Tour/Detail/Hosted/Templates/Components/TemplateItem.jsx)

  • Update fetch URL from /templates/menu/match to /v2/templates/menu/match using standard client encrypted response handling.
  • Update checkMenuOrGallery(fid) with recursive hasMatchablePano(): if menus contain only non-panorama nodes (pano_id: 0 without real panos), bypass matching and directly call POST /templates/vt/apply.

2. State & Hook Refactor (src/hooks/useMatchMenus.jsx)

  • Point endpoint URL to /v2/templates/menu/match.
  • Refactor processMenuItems(items, type) to handle recursive trees:
    • Traverse sub_menus recursively.
    • Distinguish container folders (template_pano_id = 0, isContainer: true) from matchable items (template_pano_id > 0).
    • Track template_pano_id and pano_id (selected tour pano ID).
  • Update selectMenu and unselectMenu to traverse the tree recursively and synchronize selection across all nodes sharing the same template_pano_id.

3. Sidebar Checklist View (src/components/organism/SideMenu/MatchMenu.jsx)

  • Replace the rigid 2-level rendering with a recursive tree component (<MenuTreeNode />).
  • Visually distinguish container/folder headers (pano_id === 0) with folder icons from matchable items (pano_id > 0).
  • Display indentations and matching completion checkmarks based on pano_id.

4. Dropdown Selector (src/pages/Tour/Detail/Hosted/MatchTemplate/Components/SelectMenuOrGallery.jsx)

  • Flatten select options into a direct aligned list without <SelectSection>.
  • Display direct item names (item.name) without breadcrumb prefixes.
  • Merge items with identical template_pano_id into combined labels (e.g. "Item 1, Item 2").
  • Exclude non-pano container nodes (pano_id === 0) so users only map panoramas to valid template panorama slots.
  • Preserve clear selection button (X).

5. Template Application Form (src/pages/Tour/Detail/Hosted/MatchTemplate/MatchTemplate.jsx)

  • Update disabledSave to recursively check if at least one match has been made.
  • Update getPanos() to traverse matched items recursively and build the translation map { [template_pano_id]: target_pano_id } for POST /templates/vt/apply.

6. Documentation & Tests

  • Update docs/api-endpoints.md for endpoint /v2/templates/menu/match.
  • Add unit test suites covering tree flattening, hasMatchablePano, recursive transformation, item selection, combined item merging, and unselection.

Acceptance Criteria

  • GET /v2/templates/menu/match is called using standard encrypted response handling.
  • Multi-level menus (3+ levels) parse cleanly without runtime errors in useMatchMenus.
  • Templates containing only non-pano nodes (pano_id = 0) bypass matching and apply directly.
  • Sidebar checklist renders nested hierarchy with proper indentation.
  • Container/category folders (pano_id = 0) are displayed as group labels and cannot be selected as panorama targets.
  • Dropdown in panorama cards renders flat aligned options using direct item names.
  • Items with identical template_pano_id are merged into combined labels ("Item 1, Item 2").
  • Submitting POST /templates/vt/apply sends accurate { [template_pano_id]: tour_pano_id } mapping for both root and deeply nested items.
  • Carousel/gallery items continue to match and apply correctly.

issues.display_title: Issue #4256: feat(tour): Integrate Virtual Tour Schedule API with Modal Logic
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Integrate the Virtual Tour Schedule modal (Schedule.jsx) on the Hosted Virtual Tour card with the backend API to fetch and persist activation/deactivation schedules.

Related UI/Slicing Task: #4255 (design/schedule-modal-logic)
Related Backend Issues: GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1847, GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1849, GoThruMedia/GoThru-API-New#1850

Scope & Target Files

  • src/pages/Tour/Detail/Hosted/HostedTour/Components/Overlay/HostedOverlay.jsx
  • src/pages/Tour/Detail/Hosted/HostedTour/Components/Schedule.jsx

Specification & Integration Details

1. Props Passing in HostedOverlay.jsx

Pass mid and tour_key to <Schedule />:

<Schedule mid={mid} tourKey={tour_key} />

2. Fetch Existing Schedule on Modal Open

When the schedule modal opens, retrieve existing schedule timestamps:

  • Endpoint: GET /virtualtours/schedule/{mid}?tour_key={tour_key}
  • Response Format: 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "tour_key": "xxx",
    "moderation_id": 12345,
    "foverlay": {
      "is_active": true,
      "activate_at": "2026-09-15 09:00:00",
      "deactivate_at": "2026-09-20 18:00:00"
    },
    "goverlay": { ... }
  }
}
  • State Hydration:
    • Parse foverlay.activate_at and foverlay.deactivate_at into @internationalized/date objects.
    • Pre-fill the DatePicker values if timestamps exist; leave null if empty.

3. Date Validation Rules

  • Minimum Date: Neither activateOn nor deactivateOn can be selected in the past (minValue={now(getLocalTimeZone())}).
  • Range Ordering: deactivateOn must be strictly later than activateOn (deactivateOn.compare(activateOn) > 0).
  • Validation Feedback:
    • If deactivateOn <= activateOn, set isInvalid={true} on the Deactivate DatePicker with an inline error message (t_deactivate_on.t_error).
    • Disable the Save button if the range is invalid (isRangeInvalid).
    • Allow saving if only one of the dates is set (e.g. only activateOn or only deactivateOn).
    • Both dates empty: treated as a cancel/clear schedule action.

4. Save Schedule (handleSave)

Replace the client-side setTimeout mock in Schedule.jsx (ref: #4255) with the real API call:

  • Endpoint: POST /virtualtours/schedule
  • Method: POST
  • Payload: 
    {
  "moderation_id": mid,
  "tour_key": tour_key,
  "overlay_type": "hosted",
  "schedule_activate_at": "2026-09-15 09:00:00",
  "schedule_deactivate_at": "2026-09-20 18:00:00"
}
  • Format @internationalized/date values to standard server datetime format (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss).
  • If user clears both fields, send DELETE /virtualtours/schedule/{mid}?tour_key={tour_key}&overlay_type=hosted or pass null values to remove the schedule.

5. UI & Error Handling

  • Show spinner/skeleton while fetching existing schedule on modal open.
  • Maintain isLoading={saving} on the Save button during request.
  • Display error toast if API returns an error.
  • Display success toast upon successful save and close the modal.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Builds on top of UI slicing from #4255.
  • <Schedule /> receives mid and tourKey props from HostedOverlay.jsx.
  • Opening modal retrieves existing schedule timestamps and populates the DatePickers.
  • Date Validation:
    • Blocks selecting dates in the past.
    • Enforces deactivateOn strictly greater than activateOn.
    • Shows inline error message and disables Save button on invalid range.
    • Supports setting only activateOn, only deactivateOn, or both.
  • Saving sends POST /virtualtours/schedule with formatted timestamps and overlay_type: "hosted".
  • Handles clearing/resetting schedule when fields are emptied.
  • Loading and error states handled with standard GoThru toasts and spinner.
  • Tier check for Pro/Agency remains active.

Result

  • Branch: feat/4254-schedule-button-modal
  • API Integration:
    • GET /virtualtours/schedule/{mid}?tour_key={tour_key}: Hydrates existing schedule data.
    • POST /virtualtours/schedule: Persists formatted schedule timestamps with local ⇄ UTC conversion.
    • DELETE /virtualtours/schedule/{mid}?tour_key={tour_key}&overlay_type=hosted: Clears active schedules.
  • UX & DatePicker Polish:
    • Automatically converts between local browser timezone and server UTC (09:00 WIB local -> 02:00 UTC server).
    • Smart default time on date selection (defaults to next valid future time if today is picked, or 00:00:00 for future dates).
    • Real-time validation preventing past time selection with inline error message and disabled Save button.
    • Prevented popover flickering and clipping inside modal (popoverProps & classNamesModal).
  • Tests: 100% passing across all 26 automated unit tests (Schedule.test.jsx).
